meta.source: Strava export GPX reconstruction + user-confirmed riding style + public trail-system verification
meta.note: MTB locations distinguish lift-served/downhill riding from pedal-powered trail riding. Race classification remains in the canonical event catalog.

ridingStyles.lift-served: Lift-served / downhill MTB: gravity-oriented riding where lifts provide primary uphill access.
ridingStyles.pedal: Pedal MTB: trail, cross-country, or enduro-style riding where the ride is substantially human-powered uphill and downhill.
ridingStyles.mixed: Mixed MTB: a day or location includes both lift access and meaningful pedaling.

locations.name: Trestle Bike Park / Winter Park
locations.note: User-confirmed lift-served riding at Trestle. Strava ascent reflects lift access and is not treated as pedaled climbing.

locations.name: Kokopelli Trails
locations.note: Three consecutive pedal-oriented days riding the Kokopelli trail system near Loma.

locations.name: Steamboat Bike Park
locations.note: User-confirmed lift-served riding. The Strava track also shows repeated rapid ascent resets consistent with lift access.

locations.name: Vail trail network
locations.note: User-confirmed lift-served riding. The track is strongly downhill-dominant with large vertical resets.

locations.name: Granby Ranch
locations.note: User-confirmed pedal-up ride. The Strava track lacks the repeated rapid vertical resets typical of lift-served riding.

locations.name: Crested Butte trail network
locations.note: User-confirmed mix of lift-served and pedaled riding. The Strava track also shows substantial pedaling combined with a large net descent.

locations.name: North Table Mountain
locations.note: User-confirmed fully pedaled North Table Mountain ride; first recorded ride on the new mountain bike.

locations.name: Leadville trail network
locations.note: Two separate mountain-bike activities recorded on the same day around Leadville, both showing ordinary human-powered climbing patterns.

locations.name: Royal Gorge Park
locations.note: Royal Gorge Groove race day; retained as a ridden location while the event itself remains classified as a mountain-bike race.

epicRides.location: Trestle Bike Park / Winter Park, Colorado
epicRides.note: High-volume lift-served downhill day; recorded ascent is intentionally excluded from pedaled-climbing statistics.

epicRides.name: Trestle downhill day
epicRides.location: Trestle Bike Park / Winter Park, Colorado
epicRides.note: Another high-volume lift-served downhill day; recorded ascent includes lift access.

epicRides.name: Kokopelli three-day weekend
epicRides.note: Three consecutive pedal-powered mountain-bike days on the Kokopelli trail system.
